New York Herald, 11 May 1866, p. 9, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Napoleon III (Fr), Bocande, Havre April 26,
and Brest 27th, with mdse and 124 passengers, to Geo
Mackenzie. May 1, 9 PM, lat 48 40, lon 26 21, spoke steam-
ship City of Washington, hence for Liverpool, in tow of
another steamer; did not requir e any assistance; wind blow-
ing fresh at the time; 8th, lat 41 46[?], lon 62 12[?], signalized [cut]
steamship Lafayette, hence for Havre; 9th, lat 40 46, lon 69
10, saw ship Constance, bound W.
